scripts.generate: sh -c 'set -a; if [ -f ../../.env.local ]; then . ../../.env.local; elif [ -f ../../.env ]; then . ../../.env; fi; set +a; prisma generate'
scripts.migrate: sh -c 'set -a; if [ -f ../../.env.local ]; then . ../../.env.local; elif [ -f ../../.env ]; then . ../../.env; fi; set +a; DIRECT_URL=${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}; export DIRECT_URL; prisma migrate dev'
scripts.migrate:deploy: sh -c 'DIRECT_URL=${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}; export DIRECT_URL; prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.seed: sh -c 'set -a; if [ -f ../../.env.local ]; then . ../../.env.local; elif [ -f ../../.env ]; then . ../../.env; fi; set +a; tsx prisma/seed.ts'
